title: Canals: an open-source Python workbench for open-channel hydraulic design
description: Standalone Python 3 / PySide6 workbench for classical open-channel hydraulic design. Covers optimal section design (Manning), hydraulic structures (sluice/radial gates, siphons with cavitation check, pressure breakers), regime earth-canal design (Lacey, Kennedy), gradually varied flow profiles with the twelve-curve classification, hydraulic jumps with USBR stilling-basin selection, and water-hammer screening (Korteweg wave speed, Joukowsky surge). Includes a GUI, a JSON-emitting CLI, an importable Python API, and a CI-run unit test suite. MIT license.
